user.title: Momcozy account
user.description: Sign in with the Momcozy account that owns the BM04. Setup identifies compatible cameras without opening their video session.

data_description.country_code: Use the two-letter country code configured in Momcozy (for example DE).
data_description.region: The Tuya data centre the account lives in.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Momcozy rejected the stored credentials. The cameras already configured are kept.

reconfigure.title: Momcozy account
reconfigure.description: Update the account and refresh the list of cameras it exposes.

error.auth: The email, password, country code or region is wrong.
error.connection: Could not reach the account service.
error.no_cameras: No supported Momcozy BM04 was found on this account.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The credentials belong to a different account.

data_description.keep_connected: Hold the camera session open so video and snapshots are ready instantly. The BM04 serves one client at a time, so while this is on the Momcozy app cannot connect. Turn it off to share the camera: the session then starts on demand and is released a minute after the last viewer leaves.
data_description.wake_on_snapshot: Allow snapshot and thumbnail requests to connect to a cold camera. Leave this off to prevent Home Assistant dashboards from taking the camera session away from the Momcozy app.
data_description.motion_sensitivity: How much a frame has to differ from the one before it to count as motion, as a multiple of the difference this camera shows when nothing is happening. Lower catches more and reports more false alarms.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the account is polled for camera names, availability and rotated local keys. It does not affect the video, which is pushed.

needs_power_cycle.title: {camera} has stopped answering and needs to be power cycled
needs_power_cycle.description: `{camera}` is turning down every connection with its "busy" reply, which these cameras do after a run of failed attempts and keep doing for every client — the Momcozy app cannot load the picture either. Nothing Home Assistant can do clears it: unplug the camera for a few seconds and plug it back in. Home Assistant is now retrying it slowly, and this notice disappears on its own once the camera streams again.
